envelope.description: Split tracker-auto into legacy and team mode

body.title: Split tracker-auto into legacy and team mode
body.summary: Make autoPushEpicOnHld, autoPushStoryOnLld and autoPushTasksOnPlan read the policy and pick the mode: legacy (policy none or teamMode false) runs today's code exactly, including the per-entry-point extras (the Epic and plan review comments on every push); team mode adopts through ensureUnitIssueDetailed, runs the extras through runUnitExtras, forces Task issues on, and an unreadable policy returns failed. The signatures and the terminal approve call sites stay unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: The existing tracker-auto.test.ts passes with no edit.

In team mode the three pushes adopt draft-created issues and create none, Task issues are created with pushTasks off, a failed Epic lookup returns failed, and an unreadable policy makes all three return failed.
After a draft-created Story issue the first approve runs the Epic task-list splice, the design comment and the review comment once and a second approve posts nothing.
With policy none the gh command sequence and tracker block equal the pre-change ones and pushTasks off still returns skipped.

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/approve-fallback-issues.test.ts: in team mode the three pushes adopt, force Task issues, fail on lookup or unreadable policy, and run extras once
src/workflow/__tests__/approve-fallback-issues.test.ts: with no policy the three pushes behave exactly as before
src/workflow/__tests__/tracker-auto.test.ts: the existing solo regression suite passes unedited
